## Why

D4-verify-merged-2026-09-29T04 found that squash diff `062bd840e69e` for stranske/Pension-Data#934 includes fork read-only Gate handling and `tests/test_gate_commit_status_fork_tolerance.py`, but lacks an executed deliberate-break → revert transcript with literal pytest output.

## Scope

Capture RED/GREEN evidence for the named pytest gate after a deliberate-break mutation and restoration.

## Non-Goals

Do not remove the fork tolerance behavior landed in #934.

## Tasks

- [ ] Perform the deliberate-break mutation on a branch off `main`, run `pytest tests/test_gate_commit_status_fork_tolerance.py -q`, and capture literal FAIL output.
- [ ] Restore `.github/workflows/pr-00-gate.yml` exactly, re-run `pytest tests/test_gate_commit_status_fork_tolerance.py -q`, and capture literal PASS output.
- [ ] Add RED/GREEN transcript blocks under `docs/evidence/` or the issue/PR comment thread, linked from the closing PR.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `pytest tests/test_gate_commit_status_fork_tolerance.py -q` exits 0 on `main` after restoration.
- [ ] Literal deliberate-break → revert command transcripts, including pytest FAIL and PASS output, are attached under `docs/evidence/` or in the issue/PR comment thread.

## Implementation Notes

Surfaced by D4-verify-merged-2026-09-29T04; merge `062bd840e69e`; paths: `.github/workflows/pr-00-gate.yml`, `tests/test_gate_commit_status_fork_tolerance.py`. Related: #933, merged PR #934.
